name: Glitchy Grid
description: Full-screen image grid slideshow where each chapter shows eight images in a mosaic with mouse parallax, a glitch effect on hover, and a stacked-in transition between chapters.
contents: Chapters, each with an eyebrow, a title and up to eight grid images
behavior: Images drift with eased mouse parallax
Hovering an image plays a clip-path glitch with offset copies and a flash
Changing chapter slides the old images out and stacks the new ones in with random rotation while the background shifts color
Navigation sits at the bottom right on small screens and the right edge on medium screens and up
editableByProps: Number of chapters, eyebrow and title text, images
Background, transition, text and muted colors
Parallax strength and easing, glitch offsets, transition timing, stack scale and rotation, autoplay

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the image positions in the grid

fixed: Each chapter shows at most 8 images, matching the 8 grid positions
Mouse parallax uses window mouse position and has no touch equivalent; hover glitch is desktop only
